## Context

What you want to do and cannot, or can only do the hard way. What you type today to get there, if anything.

## Proposal

What PowerJ should do. A short example of the line you would type and what it should print is worth a paragraph.

Say what is **not** part of it. If it touches a requirement of the
[specification](https://github.com/yp44/powerj/blob/main/docs/SPECIFICATION.md) (`FR-nn`), name it; a new behavior
needs a requirement of its own.

## Done when

How we know it is finished: what a test checks, what a row of the acceptance sheet says.

## References

Links: related issues, the requirement, a document, a similar feature elsewhere.
